Department-specific language minimums (e.g. Media and Communication TOPIK 5, Computer Science and Engineering TOPIK 4, Korean Language and Literature TOPIK 5, Business Administration TOPIK 4) are given only as examples; the full list is in the semester admissions guide (PDF not retrieved).
Admissions guide PDFs for Spring 2027 not downloaded/parsed; scholarship page itself says '장학금과 관련된 정확한 정보는 모집요강을 참고부탁드립니다'.
Scholarship percentages for undergraduate TOPIK/KLP/merit awards are stated as approximate ('약') of 학비; recorded at the stated percentage.
Scholarship application method / automatic award not stated for any scheme (automatic = null).
